laws.rule: It is illegal, on either side of the UN Buffer Zone, to photograph military camps, facilities, personnel or equipment, or anything that might be a security interest, even unintentionally, and to take photos within the Buffer Zone. Obey 'no photography' signs; police and military enforce these rules. Enter the zone only at designated crossing points.
